name: Kan'onji (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kan'onji city emblem in green, blue and orange: a green stylised flame beside a blue figure with an orange head.
history: Municipal flag of Kan'onji, a city in Kagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 3 July 2012; the emblem dates from 11 October 2005.

features.role: Kan'onji city emblem — a green stylised flame beside a blue figure with an orange head
